hookups.source: No operator website exists (only a Facebook page whose public header says 'Whippoorwill Campground is your horse trail destination! ... Campsites available'); the rvparking.com listing in `website` is an empty 2014 directory page. The stored water/sewer were derived from note prose resting only on directory listings (RVParking, gocampingamerica), so they are cleared. Read 2026-10-22.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the 100-site count and pull-throughs rest only on directory listings; no operator page states them (read 2026-10-22).

note: Horse-trail campground with an arena on the Onslow/Duplin county line near Beulaville, with miles of blazed equestrian trails. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 100 RV and primitive sites, some full hookup with pull-throughs, a pavilion, a swimming hole and fishing. The operator has only a Facebook page; phone from Onslow County tourism and Google. --Claude
summary: No operator website: only a Facebook page ('Whippoorwill Campground is your horse trail destination! ... Campsites available', 2,844 followers) and Onslow County tourism's listing ('Whippoorwill Campground and Arena is the Equestrians' home away from home', 300 Brinson Lane, phone 910-915-9854). Google Maps: 'Whippoorwill Camp Ground', 188 Brinson Ln, 4.6 stars / 51 reviews, phone 910-915-9854, no website. Cleared directory-only water/sewer, site count and pull-throughs. Note rewritten: dropped the undated directory prices and the 'Not equestrian-only' claim, which no operator page supports.
flags: Criteria (horse camp?): every operator-side description is equestrian. Facebook: 'Whippoorwill Campground is your horse trail destination!'; Onslow County tourism: 'Whippoorwill Campground and Arena is the Equestrians' home away from home ... miles of trails specially maintained for equestrians'. The inclusion evidence that it is a general campground rests only on RVParking/gocampingamerica directories. A human should decide whether non-horse RV campers are welcome (a call to 910-915-9854 would settle it).

Website is an aggregator: https://www.rvparking.com/nc/beulaville/whippoorwill-campground is an empty directory page (0 reviews, blank site fields, 'Copyright 2014'). The operator has no website; its own page is https://www.facebook.com/Whippoorwill-Campground-245843888832670/ .
Phone: Onslow County tourism and Google Maps both give 910-915-9854; the entry has 910-324-2619.

Presence/price: Facebook-only operator, but Google Maps shows it open with 51 reviews (4.6) and a phone, so presence passes on the Google path. No operator rate at all (directory figures W/E $20, full $25 are undated); price indicator is only RV Life's $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km (Raleigh 130 km). Family has not stayed here.
